checks: The scoring page mounts two separate shared settings cards with helpful empty states
Available formats show their names, set counts and exactly one labelled tournament default
Regular and last-set summaries preserve points, break thresholds and both pause durations
Disabled intervals, explicit zero pauses and unset pauses remain distinguishable
Only deviations are listed, sorted by discipline and stage, with numeric and string IDs resolving equally
Identical live snapshots cause zero scoring DOM mutations and preserve keyboard focus
An assignment-only update keeps both format summaries and existing assignment rows mounted
The existing editor opens by keyboard with imported names, set counts and locked point values intact
Saving a pause retains the existing command and imported rules while converting minutes:seconds to milliseconds
A failed save keeps the editor and the edited pause available for retry
The server broadcast preceding a local save response does not claim that another window changed the format
Confirmed pause changes update the existing summary without rebuilding other formats or assignments
The edit icon opens the correct format and another format change preserves its editor
An external change to the currently edited format closes the matching stale editor with an explanation
A changed BTP default updates the badge and resolves formerly inherited assignments without stale exceptions
Reordering formats moves the existing nodes instead of replacing them
An unavailable explicitly assigned format is shown as unavailable rather than silently as the default
Removing imported data returns both cards to honest empty states and removes obsolete nodes
A tournament without explicit deviations states that all stages use its known default
A subsequent successful edit clears the earlier external-change notice
Scoring cards, all rules and assignment rows fit without horizontal scrolling at 1920

Unchanged scoring dialogs cannot submit a redundant save
On desktop the two set sections stand side by side within the scrollable dialog body
Editing a pause enables Apply and changes Close to Cancel
Restoring the original pause returns the scoring dialog to its unchanged state
Invalid durations show an explanation in the dialog and cannot save
Closing a changed scoring dialog asks before discarding its draft

Forward Tab navigation wraps to the shared header close button

Escape and backdrop clicks cannot dismiss an in-flight scoring save
A save failure keeps the draft, unlocks editing and explains the error inside the modal
A late successful response cannot close a newly opened scoring editor
An inactive interval retains its cached times and disables only its dependent fields and arrows
